verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing docs explicitly claim seamless sync with chat tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, and Lark, and webhooks are documented as the general integration mechanism for custom workflows including notifications. However, there is no independent or hands-on evidence confirming these chat integrations work well in practice, nor detail on what 'activity' data syncs beyond generic webhook events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of chat notification sync, detail on which repository events (issues, PRs, commits) actually propagate to chat tools, and confirmation this isn't just a generic webhook with third-party glue.
